Name: More Rabbits Than You'll Ever Need (AnS)
Author: HannahBug
Description:
Originally this was going to be a vanilla-based recolor, but I just couldn't abide by the default rabbit sprites... They shuffle around like sleeping bags with ears pinned on.... Thus, the sideways-facing sprites have been relined for both adults and kits in a hopefully vanilla-like style! Featuring things such as rounded backs, slightly more oval-shaped heads, hopping, and bunnies sitting like loaves of bread : )

The walking animation has four unique sprites, which I haven't messed with before. So sometimes sideways-facing rabbits will sit on frame 4, which has the hind legs pulled up very far for landing, and I know not why. But, I think it's kinda cute, so I'm not gonna puzzle over that. They're sitting like a people, hehe ♪

Kits come in flat colors. Grow them to adults to see what patterns they'll have! There were more patterns and colors I wanted to do, but if I don't get this dang thing out, I never will...!
[b]
[/b]Includes:[b]
13 Base Colors: [/b]Vanilla tweak, albino (/red-eyed white), black, blue, brown, chocolate, cream, grey, lilac, mist, orange, tan, red
[b]7 Patterns: [/b]Solid, Dutch, Cali(fornian), eyeliner, leg, English, blaze
[b]2 Unique Buns: [/b]Blue-eyed white, panda
[b]Total: [/b]93 options

These are just sprites, so they will not work on their own!
[b]Intended to be used with:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'N' Skin
[/url]If you prefer [b]Alternate Textures[/b], paicream has made a version for that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22819]here[/url]! ❤️
